Subject: Vendor preboarding & PO intake — checklist and next steps

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the quick call this morning and welcome aboard. To get your account and the first purchase order set up with Redwood, our procurement team needs a short set of documents and a few confirmations from your side. Below is a compact checklist to speed the intake process. If you can return items 1–4 by EOD Thursday (PST) we’ll be able to issue a PO the same day.

What we need from you (OceanaCloud):
- Completed vendor preboarding spreadsheet (attached). Please fill all tax fields and one primary remittance address.
- Signed W-9 or equivalent tax form (or W-8 if non-US) — scan is fine.
- Primary billing contact name + email and AP hours/timezone.
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number) OR payment terms if invoice-only.
- Any vendor-specific insurance certificate (if available) — we can accept a follow-up within 7 days for certificates.

What Redwood will provide / do once we receive items:
- Create vendor master record and return Redwood vendor ID.
- Draft PO and send for AP approval (we aim for 4 business hours after record creation).
- Share PO instructions PDF that shows how to format invoices for faster processing.
- Set up automated invoice route to your finance inbox and provide expected payment terms.

Attachments included: Vendor_Preboarding_Form.xlsx, Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf, Redwood_W-9_Template.pdf

A couple of notes:
- If you prefer Net-30 versus ACH, let us know and include the billing contact to speed approvals.
- For any SSO/API integration details (billing reference fields we can accept), we’ll follow up from the integrations team — not blocking PO issuance.

Next step: Please confirm the billing contact and return the completed spreadsheet + W-9. I’ll loop in Laura (procurement lead) if we need to escalate timing.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0164

Hi Maya / Jordan —

Received the files, thanks. I’ve started the vendor master entry and will confirm the Redwood vendor ID by 1:00pm PST. A couple of clarifications from procurement/finance side:

1) Invoice formatting: Please include the invoice date, our PO number (we’ll add it before sending the PO), line-item descriptions, and the bank remittance details. We do not require the Redwood vendor ID on the first invoice but it helps for matching on future payments — we will email the vendor ID once the master record is created.

2) ACH handling: For security we upload bank details into our secure AP portal. If your finance team prefers, they can send an encrypted PDF to ap@redwoodinference.com or use the secure upload link I’ll send in a separate email.

3) Payment terms: Default is Net-30 unless you requested otherwise in the spreadsheet. If you’ll need Net-45 or custom terms, please confirm and we’ll route for additional approval.

4) Insurance: If the certificate isn’t available immediately, we can proceed with PO issuance provided you commit to deliver the insurance evidence within 7 calendar days.

I’m attaching the PO instructions PDF for your AP. Once I have the vendor ID I’ll reply-all with the PO and next steps for invoice submission.

Laura Bennett
